---
description: Premium, intuitive UX rules inspired by Appel; fast navigation required
applyTo: "frontend/**/*.ts,frontend/**/*.tsx"
---

- The experience must be **extremely intuitive**: obvious navigation, immediate feedback, and predictable interfaces.
- Users must be able to reach any key feature or main page in **no more than 3 clicks**.
- Critical flows (signup, payment, main navigation) should be effortless—no unnecessary steps or long forms.
- Use **Sonner** to notify users instantly about any important action or error (success, error, warning, confirmation).
- Always provide “undo” or cancellation for sensitive actions (deletion, critical changes).
- Prioritize immediate feedback: show loading indicators, visual cues, and notifications.
- Centralize error handling, displaying clear and actionable error messages to users.
- Always prioritize simplicity in UX decisions: short menus, clear labels, no technical jargon.
- Detect and minimize friction points (user testing, Appel’s heuristics).
- Integrate **2025 best practices**:
  - Inclusive design (cognitive accessibility, plain language)
  - Micro-interactions to reassure users
  - Contextual navigation (guided flows, timely tooltips)
  - Powerful search if relevant (catalog, products)
  - Persistent user preferences (theme, UI settings)
- Users should never be left wondering “what to do next”: the next action is always clearly indicated.
